Card.name: MOTW Coffee and Pastries
Card.description: At MOTW Coffee Shop, every sip is a statement of solidarity and every visit a step towards greater understanding and unity. We invite you to be a part of our ongoing journey, to experience the essence of MOTW in every corner of our café, and to continue spreading the message of hope and humanity that has always been at the heart of our mission.

Card.name: Burtons Grill & Bar
Card.description: From spice mixes & sauces to decadent desserts, we make everything from scratch. Our ingredients are sourced from trusted partners who share our dedication to quality & integrity.

Card.name: Patel Brothers
Card.description: This grocery chain sells Indian foods, plus beauty products, spiritual items & more.

Card.name: Castinetti Realty Group
Card.description: As a licensed REALTOR® since 2015 and Broker-Owner of Castinetti Realty Group, I place service at the heart of everything I do! My team and I are fully committed to our community and giving generously, consistently and intentionally. Treating our clients like family, we work hard to demonstrate our commitment to you through every chapter of your buying and selling journey. Beyond traditional buying and selling, we specialize in working with first-time homebuyers, lease and rentals, divorces, relocations, and commercial properties, offering the expertise and support to make your real estate experience a success. After every sale, we donate to a local charity of our client’s choice in their name. Proudly serving all of Massachusetts, Northeast Connecticut, Rhode Island, and Southern Maine!

Card.name: The Ground Round
Card.description:
Welcome to The Ground Round where We've Got What You Like!
‍
The re-imagined and reinvented Ground Round successfully honors its legacy while catering to a modern dining experience. It’s a place where you can relive fond childhood memories while savoring a thoughtfully prepared, high-quality meal. It’s not just a comeback; it’s a revival, a testament to the enduring appeal of good food, good company, and the comforting embrace of nostalgia, now served with an elevated twist. The warm, inviting atmosphere encourages gatherings, laughter, and the kind of unpretentious camaraderie that defined the original. Come rediscover the magic.

Card.name: Amici Trattoria
Card.description:
Amici is the Italian word for friends and that's what Amici Trattoria is all about. A convivial place for folks to meet, Amici Trattoria features a cozy, casual atmosphere, a large and varied menu of delectable food, a full bar and a nice wine list. Amici's chef prepares a wide selection of specialties influenced by the Italian peninsula, Sicily and Sardinia. Our menu has something for everyone, from:

The risotto of Milan, the cured meats and filled pastas of Bologna, the polenta of the Alps, the pesto of Genoa, the pizza of Naples, and all the southern Italian-American favorites too.

Our daily specials highlight the rustic cooking of the Italian countryside, seashores and mountains. Gluten-free and vegetarian menu items are also included.

Dessert is a sweet ending to a satisfying meal and we offer several house-made confections as well as selections from the area's finest bakers. Paired with a smooth cappuccino or espresso, it's the perfect complement to the warm and friendly vibe at Amici Trattoria.

Come join us, and see why Amici's is "Where Friends Meet"
